opportunities.name: Booking.com flight search and select fastest direct flight
opportunities.description: On Booking.com Flights, search a one-way or multi-city itinerary for given origin/destination legs, dates and number of adults with direct flights only. Sort by Fastest, select the top flight and pick a ticket type (flexible) before continuing.
steps: Open Booking.com and click the Flights tab
Choose the trip type (One way / Round trip / Multi-city)
Check 'Direct flights only' if it's needed
Remove the default origin, type the origin city and pick the airport
Type the destination city and pick the airport
Open the departure date picker and choose the date
For multi-city, fill the origin, destination and date of each additional leg
Set the number of adults in the travellers dropdown and click Done
Click Search
Apply the Direct only stop filter or a departure time filter if needed
Click the Fastest sort tab
Click 'See flight' on the top result, then click Select
Choose the Flexible ticket option and click Next

instances.values: One-way BLR Bangalore -> GOI Goa, 29 Mar 2023, 2 adults, direct only, departure 18:00-23:59, Fastest, SpiceJet $428.38, flexible ticket
Multi-city New York -> Tokyo on 1 Jun 2023 and Tokyo -> Delhi (DEL) on 5 Jun 2023, 1 adult, direct only, Fastest, Japan Airlines $1,038.50, flexible ticket

opportunities.name: Expedia rental car search with filters
opportunities.description: On Expedia Cars, search rental cars for a given pick-up/drop-off location, dates and times. Then filter by car type, capacity or rental company, and sort the results.
steps: Open Expedia and click the Cars tab
Click Pick-up, type the location and pick the suggestion
Optionally set a drop-off location (type it and pick the suggestion)
Open the date picker, choose the pick-up and drop-off dates, then click Done
Optionally set the pick-up and drop-off times
Click Search
Check the filter checkboxes (car type, capacity, rental company)
Optionally change Sort by (e.g. Total Price)

instances.values: JFK pick-up/drop-off, Apr 3-6 2023, 9:00 am-6:00 pm, filters 2-5 passengers + Luxury, sort Total Price (interrupted, resumed at 2179s)
San Francisco, same drop-off, Apr 8-9 2023, 10:30 am, filters Avis + Economy

opportunities.name: Carnival cruise search with destination, port, date and guests
opportunities.description: On Carnival, search cruises by sail-to destination, sail-from port and month. Then adjust the number of guests on the results page to compare prices.
steps: Open the Carnival homepage
Click Sail To and choose a destination
Optionally click Sail From and choose a departure port
Optionally click Dates and choose a month
Click SEARCH CRUISES
On the results page, open Number of Guests and set the count with +/-
Review the result prices

instances.values: Panama Canal, from San Francisco CA, Oct 2024
Caribbean, any port, any date, guests changed to 3 and then 4

opportunities.name: MTA planned service changes lookup by route and date
opportunities.description: On new.mta.info, open Planned Service Changes, search for a subway or bus route and optionally pick a date to see planned work.
steps: Open new.mta.info
Click 'Planned Work' (or Menu > Planned Service Changes)
Type the route name in Search Routes
Pick the route from the list
Optionally open Select Date, move through the months and pick a date
Read the results

opportunities.name: SpotHero airport parking search
opportunities.description: On SpotHero, search airport parking for a given airport and optionally set the parking dates and sort order.
steps: Open SpotHero and click the Airport tab
Type the airport name or code in the search box
Pick the airport from the suggestions
Optionally set the parking start and end dates in the calendar
Optionally change the sort (e.g. Shuttle Time)
